Check the condition of the rear shock absorber.

Proceed as follows to replace the shock absorbers.

If the shock absorbers have been fitted for more than 20,000/25,000, always replace both shock absorbers on each axle together, taking care to fit shock absorbers of the same type from those available as parts to the same axle.

If the shock absorbers have been fitted for less than 20,000/25,000, only one shock absorber may be replaced provided the new one is the same type and after checking that the other shock absorber is operating efficiently.

Fit the rear shock absorber.

Screw in the upper bolt securing the shock absorber to the body without tightening.

Screw in the lower bolt securing the shock absorber to the body without tightening.

Remove the hydraulic jack.

Op. 4450B06 LEFT REAR WHEEL R R

Or:

Op. 4450B08 RIGHT REAR WHEEL R R

Remove the vehicle from the lift.

Adjust the vehicle to conditions of theoretical design load to tighten the bolts screwed in previously to torque.

Move the vehicle to a platform lift so that the wheels are resting on the ground.
